logistics.format: Web-based proctored, open-book reference (ProctorU or PearsonVUE)

recommended_certs.rationale: GPEN でオンプレ侵入テストの素養を持ったうえで、AWS/Azure/コンテナ/CI/CD まで踏み込む GCPN に進むと評価が立体的になる。

plus.note: クラウド/CI-CD 攻撃に特化した認証は希少で、SANS SEC588 の権威性が高い。

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Cloud and CI/CD assessment with a three-year profile supports professional testing scope, reinforced by accreditation; the open-book format limits evidence of practical offensive delivery beyond the recorded hint.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Accredited cloud and CI/CD offensive coverage with a three-year profile supports professional cloud-pentest knowledge. The supplied exam lacks a stated practical component, so engagement execution should be separately tested.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded cloud, container and CI/CD offensive scope is directly relevant to modern engagements at a three-year level. I accept professional knowledge depth but do not infer extended practical execution from the open-book format.
